title: Too Much Wing
subject: Kylie vs. the stage door
subtitle: A $50m look. Three tiny doors. Get these wings to the car.
description: A fictional backstage comedy inspired by Kylie Jenner’s October 2026 runway look: oversized white wings, a jeweled outfit and very ordinary doors. Hold Tuck to squeeze past clothing racks, cameras and crew, then reach the pickup car. Original cartoon art. Unofficial; no affiliation or endorsement.

result_loss: $50m outfit. Defeated by a standard doorway.
